newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's forex kerb market shut on strike.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's forex kerb market shut on strike.

text.p: Pakistan's forex kerb market stayed shut on Saturday due to separate strikes called by transporters and religious factions in Karachi, dealers said.
Private transport operators went on strike to press the government to allow buses, taxis and motorised rickshaws to raise fares after successive fuel increases in recent months.

The strike coincided with a province-wide strike staged by several small religious factions against the inclusion in the Sindh provincial government of a minister belonging to the Ahmadi religious sect, which they regard as heretical.
